skill.name: gpt-taste
skill.description: Guides AI assistants to create premium frontend pages with varied layouts, AIDA structure, wide hero typography, dense bento grids, GSAP motion, and visual preflight checks.
skill.summary: Create varied, motion-rich React page designs with GSAP and strict layout checks.
skill.author: leonxlnx

security_audit.summary: Most external-command alerts are false positives caused by Markdown inline code in design instructions, not executable backtick usage. One low-severity network issue is confirmed because SKILL.md directs generated UIs to load images from picsum.photos. No prompt injection text or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the picsum.photos instruction with local assets, user-provided assets, or consent before generated code loads remote images.
Rephrase the Python randomization section to require deterministic planning choices, not simulated script execution.

content.value_statement: Generic AI pages often repeat weak layouts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward varied editorial UI, GSAP motion, and stricter visual checks.
actual_capabilities: Directs assistants to plan navigation, AIDA page flow, and footer before UI code.
Requires deterministic layout selection among hero, typography, component, and GSAP options.
Specifies GSAP ScrollTrigger patterns including pinning, scrubbing, scaling, and stacking.
Defines bento grid density checks using Tailwind grid-flow-dense and span verification.
Sets rules for wide hero typography, button contrast, image styling, and large spacing.
limitations: Does not include executable code, scripts, or bundled components.
Depends on the host AI and project stack to implement React and GSAP correctly.
May over-prescribe large spacing and heavy animation for utilitarian products.
References a third-party placeholder image service that may not fit production policies.

use_cases.title: Design Agency Landing Pages
use_cases.description: Create a polished landing page brief with strong hero typography, clear AIDA flow, and motion directions.

use_cases.title: Startup Product Launches
use_cases.description: Turn a product concept into a premium React page plan with CTAs, bento sections, and animated proof points.

use_cases.title: Frontend Motion Prototypes
use_cases.description: Guide implementation of ScrollTrigger sections, hover states, and image reveals for review prototypes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Premium Landing Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gpt-taste to design a single-page React landing page for [product]. Include navigation, hero, feature section, motion section, and footer.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Hero and Grid
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current page direction for [brand]. Apply the wide hero rule, button contrast check, and gapless bento grid guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Plan GSAP Interactions
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an interaction plan for [page type]. Choose two GSAP scroll patterns and explain how they support the AIDA sections.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Implementation Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Before code generation for [project], produce the design plan with deterministic layout choices, grid density checks, and contrast checks.

output_examples.input: A SaaS founder asks for a launch page for an analytics product.
output_examples.output: The skill directs a wide hero, two clear CTAs, a dense feature grid, and a pinned proof section with scroll motion.

output_examples.input: A frontend engineer wants stronger motion for a portfolio page.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends image scale reveals, hover transformations, and a preflight plan that checks spacing, button contrast, and grid density.

output_examples.input: A designer asks to reduce generic AI layout choices.
output_examples.output: The skill forces deterministic layout variation, font selection, and component selection before the assistant writes UI.

best_practices: Use the design plan as a review step before accepting generated UI code.
Replace placeholder image URLs with approved brand assets before production.
Check motion performance and reduced-motion behavior during implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill for dense operational dashboards that need restrained layouts.
Do not accept simulated planning claims as proof that code was executed.
Do not ship remote placeholder images without approval.

faq.question: Does this skill run Python code?
faq.answer: No. It asks the assistant to make deterministic design choices. It does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: Does it require GSAP?
faq.answer: The instructions prefer GSAP and ScrollTrigger. Projects without GSAP need an adapted motion approach.

faq.question: Can it create production code?
faq.answer: It can guide generated frontend code, but implementation quality depends on the host model and project setup.

faq.question: Why does it mention picsum.photos?
faq.answer: It suggests placeholder images for visual richness. Production work should use approved local or licensed assets.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Is it suitable for every website?
faq.answer: No. It favors expressive marketing and portfolio pages over quiet utility interfaces.
